Definition: genitive case (as adverb of place) of a presumed derivative of G3956; universally:--in all places, everywhere.
BiblicalUsage: Pantachou means everywhere, in every place. The fame of Jesus spreads abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee, and Paul tells the Athenians that God commands all men every where to repent.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that everywhere is the gospel's geography: His fame spreads through Galilee, and His command to repent reaches every place on earth.
